title: Grateful Dead Live at Compton Terrace Amphitheatre on 1992-12-06
source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; AKGC451EB/CK1's (DIN/DFC/First Row Of OTS/6 Feet High)> Whirlwind Phantoms>Sony TC-D5M,Tapes Set 1 Maxell MX-s,Set 2 Maxell MX; Transfer Information:Tascam 112 MKII (XLR Out)>Tascam HD-P2 @ 24/48> HDD>Amadeus Pro (Tracking/Fades/FLAC8); Tracks Renamed/Metadata Tagging With AudioGate Software By Keo

ai_review.summary: Excellent recording featuring the historic first performance of “Here Comes Sunshine” since 1974.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this tape as a great‑sounding capture of an excellent show, highlighting the rarity of hearing ‘Here Comes Sunshine’ after more than two decades. No technical flaws are mentioned, and the set is noted for its special moment rather than any shortcomings.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent, high‑rating reviews (5★ and 4★) emphasize both superb sound quality and a notable song appearance, leading to an overall strong rating despite the limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the recording as great with no reported issues; source type not specified.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is highlighted for featuring ‘Here Comes Sunshine’, its first appearance since 1974, marking a special moment in the set.
